title: agent.mock.Agent
description: A validated Mock Agent with its computed content-addressed ID.

client_objectiveai_mcp.description:
Client-side ObjectiveAI MCP surface the calling client is
expected to expose locally back to the API (objectiveai
built-in, plus specific plugins / tools by owner+name+version).

error.description: If true, the mock client will return an error instead of a response.

error_probability.description:
Probability (0-100) that the mock returns an error mid-stream.
Requires `error` to be `Some(true)`.

id.description: The deterministic content-addressed ID (22-character base62 string).

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers the agent can connect to.

output_mode.description: The output mode for vector completions. Ignored for agent completions.

top_logprobs.description:
Number of top log probabilities to return (2-20).

**Vector completions only.** Ignored for agent completions.
